description: This file is a shell script that defines functions and variables used for CI (Continuous Integration) setup across different CI systems like GitHub Actions and GitLab CI. It handles environment detection, cache management, build skipping logic, and configurations specific to various operating systems and CI environments.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips build if the branch is exactly at a tag, preventing redundant build runs.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid Git repository and Git is available.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Stores the current Git tree SHA for build caching purposes.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Skips building if the current Git tree SHA has been built and tested successfully before.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Verifies there are no unignored build artifacts in the repository.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Handles actions after test failures; implementation provided for CI-specific behavior.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Creates and stores artifacts related to failed tests for debugging.
